in_sanskrit.name: Gunavan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Power, Strength, Victor
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gunavan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘gun’ (power, strength) and ‘avan’ (victor). This name symbolizes the power and strength of a victor. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of various deities and legendary figures who have displayed immense power and courage.
